notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
Hello!
This is my first post in Steam Community and first No Parachute update.

First, I want to thank everyone who purchased and wishlisted the game. I didn't expect over 400 sales in first month. It motivates me to spend more time on development. 

[h2]Update changelog[/h2]
* Added Endless level. It's proceduraly generated every time you play it
* Added Daily challenge mode. Play a new level every day and compare your score to other players in leaderboards
* Added friends leaderboards for story mode levels

* Fixed Vents 3 - removed the pipe ːsteamsadː
* Fixed Flesh Hell 3 - added more contrast to obstacles, fixed level name
